subject: Proposal from architect
body: Re-propose after plan-phase consensus-timeout reset (all agents back to WORKING). Artifacts unchanged and already at the shared branch tip. Plan-phase architecture analysis + slices scaffold for issue #3364 — three mutually-independent slices, distinct risk. Slice 1 / PR B (low/additive): --exclude-types/--quiet client-side filter flags on the pure-stdlib wait-status launcher (applied at the two json print sites :249/:271) + new SLICE_CLOSED EventType (events.py:35) emitted via an injected emitter callback in SliceScheduler.record_complete/record_failure (mirroring the existing _hitl_escalator post-lock injection seam), added to _STATUS_WAIT_EVENT_TYPES. Slice 2 / PR C (medium-high/behavioral, supervision_policy.py + JobSupervisor): new transient rate-limit classification off the all-producers throttling-streak signature (429/rate-limit/overloaded — the signatures auth_errors.py keeps off EX_AUTH_FATAL) so it bypasses the 30s-capped agent-invocation-fail-streak halt; windowed hours-scale paced retry via a restart_phase-equivalent preserving landed slices; deterministic-loop guard escalating on identical-failure reproduction; cq-1 binding = unbounded retry + threshold OVERSEER_ALERT (no hard ceiling); EX_AUTH_FATAL/abnormal unchanged. Slice 3 / PR D (medium/deletion, GATED, split D1 coverage-map -> D2 SKILL.md deletion + D3 flag removal): coverage-map each of the five host detector blocks to a concrete overseer emitter BEFORE deleting — host vocab (agent-stall/silent/nack/long-running) lives in prod only as a state.py dedup map and is otherwise LLM-classifier-produced, distinct from the deterministic overseer emitters (post_consensus_stall, etc.), so parity is real verification; preserve AC-D3 render-on-alert flows; remove overseer_owns_host_detection entirely (field + 2 refs, grep-clean); HITL any block with no confirmed emitter. DAG: three independent slices, no cross-blocking edges, PR D internally gated.
